name: DeepSeek V4 Flash

performance.note: The opt-in DSpark5 batch-one greedy profile measured a three-trial median 14.02 tok/s and 0.515 s warm TTFT over 128 tokens with 6,304 expert slots and a 0.45 confidence threshold. Safe compressor-prefix commits replace the faulty first-rejection shortcut. The corrected replay control measured 11.50 tok/s; the previous published profile recorded 13.15 tok/s. Over 256 tokens, prefix commits measured 9.96 tok/s versus 8.27 for corrected replay and 8.79 for the single-trial target-only control. Target-only remains the default.

description: Fused DS-FP4 Frontier recipe with GPU-first expert residency, SM121 small-row kernels, optional replay-free DSpark speculative decoding, and route-first sparse prefill on one NVIDIA GB10.
limitations: The 64K context and 60-minute agent gates have not passed.
Capability, quality, parser, and agent gates remain incomplete.

The selected DSpark5 profile remains opt-in and batch-one greedy. It reached 14.02 tok/s over 128 tokens and 9.96 tok/s over 256 tokens; these focused probes are not broad task-suite scores, and target-only/replay/verification traces can differ.
The previous DSpark first-rejection shortcut captured state on the wrong execution path. Its historical numbers remain archived, not a correctness reference for the current decoder.
The zero-entry host LRU is tuned for GB10 unified memory, where host and GPU allocations compete for the same physical capacity; discrete-GPU systems may benefit from a host LRU.
The 512-token sparse-prefill threshold is optimized for short interactive prompts; longer prefills retain the bounded full-layer streaming path.
